title: Inspect and extend: Connect report, chat, and settings screens
objective: Use the real implementation in `App.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve navigation tabs, shared controls/theme, action wiring, and ui status.
problem: The same data model supports several screens. Follow each control’s handler back to context/model methods and distinguish display values from persisted settings. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `App.tsx` and the related project files: src/screens/ReportsScreen.tsx; src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx; src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx; src/components.tsx; src/theme.ts; App.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to navigation tabs, shared controls/theme, action wiring, and ui status.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The UI does not implement identity, backend sync, or payment settlement.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: The same data model supports several screens. Follow each control’s handler back to context/model methods and distinguish display values from persisted settings.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `App.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
